bundle.shortDescription: A morphing island and Command Center that replace the Windows taskbar
bundle.longDescription: Island Shell puts a Dynamic Island-style pill at the top of the screen in place of the Windows taskbar: music with lyrics, Discord calls, sound, your day, games and your PC, plus a full-screen Command Center with search and a Task Manager.
